d:
The Animatronics at Freddy Frickbear's Pizza are hyped for another night of terrifying a helpless nightguard. Too bad Fritz is on the job!
Inspired by 80s Glam Rock, Electronic music & Tangos, OVERTIME is finally released! This track has been in the works for months, with tons of help from the official frickbear's team, both in terms of voice acting and artwork/direction! I hope you enjoy the fruits of everyone's hard work!
Written, Composed, Arranged, Edited & (Partially) Performed by RecD
